description: This file defines security-related functions for password hashing, verification, and JWT token creation and decoding within a Python backend application. It manages password encryption with bcrypt and handles JWT token generation and validation, including expiration handling.

methods.name: str hash_password(plain_password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt and bcrypt's hashing function.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a bcrypt hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with optional expiration and extra claims.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, returning its payload or raising an error.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optio/
ctags.signature: (subject: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
